name: document_ocr
description: OCR and structured extraction for scanned documents and images. Use for 'read this scanned PDF', 'OCR this image', 'extract structured data from this scan', or 'what's on this scanned document'. Use action=ocr for page-attributed Markdown from scanned PDFs, PNG, JPEG, WebP, BMP, or TIFF; action=extract to turn that OCR text into instructed text, Markdown, or schema-validated JSON; action=archive to save OCR outputs and crops; or action=status to check service health. Accepts Stash references or policy-approved local files and saves full outputs to Stash by default. Prefer pdf_read for born-digital PDF text, metadata, search, merge, split, and page rendering. Prefer analyze_image for a photo question that is not OCR. It does not generate images.

stash_ref.description: Input Stash URI such as stash://space_id/file_id. Use exactly one input source: stash_ref, space_id+file_id, or file_path.

space_id.description: Input Stash space ID when used with file_id.

file_id.description: Input Stash file ID or name when used with space_id.

file_path.description: Policy-approved local PDF or image path. Prefer stash_ref for Web UI uploads and do not combine this with another input source.

page_start.description: Optional first 1-indexed PDF page to process.

page_end.description: Optional last 1-indexed PDF page to process, inclusive.

keep_region_tags.description: Keep layout/region tags in OCR Markdown. Default true.

include_region_data.description: Embed figure crops as Base64 data URLs in the full OCR JSON. Default false. Use only with a narrow page range; prefer action=archive for complete crop collections because JSON responses are bounded to 25 MB.

prompt.description: Required for action=extract. Instruction applied to the OCR text.

scope.description: For action=extract, apply the instruction to the whole document or separately per page. Default document.

response_format.description: For action=extract, requested output format. Use json with json_schema for strict structured extraction. Default text.

json_schema.description: Optional JSON Schema object for action=extract with response_format=json. Remote schema references are rejected.

max_new_tokens.description: Optional output-token cap. For OCR it applies per OCR page. For extract it applies to each generation-backend call and the host may impose a lower per-call limit. With scope=page, selected page count multiplied by the effective value must fit the host's aggregate max_generate_request_tokens budget; use a narrow page range or lower value. action=status reports the active limits.

save_to_stash.description: Save complete OCR/extraction outputs to Stash. Default true. When false, only bounded inline excerpts and structured page results that fit the shared preview budget are returned; omitted content is not recoverable. Archive is always saved.

output_space_id.description: Optional existing Stash space for outputs; otherwise a new OCR space is created.

output_name.description: Optional safe base filename for saved OCR outputs.

availability.setup_hint: Set OVIS_OCR_URL to the root URL of a reachable OVIS FastAPI service in the active mode env file.
